# Amazon Simple Workflow Service

Coordinate local deciders and activity workers through durable workflow histories, task polling, timers and timeouts.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `swf` |
| Signing name | `swf` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2012-01-25` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Real local workflow coordination; workers and deciders run in clients |
| Selected operations | 39 of 39 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-simple-workflow-service) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SWF Flow framework, cross-region coordination or imported history; history contains only local recorded events.
- ScheduleLambdaFunction records ScheduleLambdaFunctionFailed with LAMBDA_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION; no Lambda invocation. Lambda roles are rejected on execution start.
- Sticky decision task lists are unsupported and rejected; no AWS distributed delivery latency, throttling or service quota simulation.
- Timeout and retention transitions use a 100 ms local worker and wall-clock deadlines; NONE disables individual task deadlines within the workflow execution deadline.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
